thread:
alex: Heads-up — onboarding blocked by sampleapp. Team creation via Node SDK returns 200 but no invite emails sent. Can someone take a look?

nina: Repro on my machine. Direct REST POST to /v1/admin/teams with payload {\"name\":\"team-x\",\"invite_users\":true} creates invites. SDK call `client.admin.createTeam({ name: 'team-x', inviteUsers: true })` returns success but invites not generated.

omar: Did you capture the outgoing HTTP body from the SDK? Might be a serializer issue.

alex: Captured traffic: SDK outgoing body is `{\"name\":\"team-x\"}` — `inviteUsers` omitted entirely. Token scopes are correct.

jen: That suggests the admin namespace wasn't included in the new codegen mapping. We recently changed generator templates; some namespaces lost automatic camelCase -> snake_case mapping.

omar: Minimal repro (Node):
```js
await client.admin.createTeam({
  name: 'team-x',
  inviteUsers: true
});
```
Working curl example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/teams \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{\"name\":\"team-x\",\"invite_users\":true}'
```

nina: Proposal: change SDK serializer to map camelCase -> snake_case for admin endpoints and add unit tests. Also add an integration test that verifies invites are created when inviteUsers=true.

alex: Short-term mitigation: sampleapp will POST directly to admin REST for the create flow to unblock the e2e test. We'll revert once SDK fix lands.

jen: Also spotted a retry mismatch: SDK runtime is retrying on 409 and doing exponential backoff; REST clients treat client errors (4xx) as permanent. This behavior can cause duplicate attempts and confusing logs (e.g., duplicate user errors).

omar: Agree — update retry classifier to treat 400..499 as non-retriable except 429. If there are endpoints that legitimately use transient 409, server should return Retry-After or use 5xx. We can also add per-endpoint override flags.

nina: I'll open two PRs: (1) generator template fix to ensure admin param mapping; (2) runtime retry classification change + tests.

alex: Created tracking ticket: https://redwood.internal/p/SDK-ONBOARD-957 to track serializer parity, retry change, and sampleapp hotfix.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #4012 — unit tests queued.

jen: Thanks all. Ping me when PRs merge and I'll coordinate sampleapp revert. :thumbsup:
